name: Phrozen Sonic Mini 8K S - 22-Micron Pixel Resin 3D Printer
short_description: Compact resin printer with 7,500×3,240 pixel (8K) resolution and 7.1-inch mono LCD. 22-micron pixel size for exceptional detail. Ideal for high-detail miniatures and jewelry.

name: Creality Sonic Pad - Klipper Tablet to Supercharge Your 3D Printer
short_description: 7-inch touchscreen controller running Klipper firmware. Multiplies your existing printer’s speed up to 5x while improving print quality. Compatible with 80+ Creality printers.

name: BIQU H2 V2S Direct Drive Extruder - Lightweight Upgrade for Your 3D Printer
short_description: Direct drive extruder weighing only 217g with 7:1 gear ratio. Supports temperatures up to 300°C and flexible materials like TPU. Perfect upgrade for Ender and CR-10 printers.

name: Elegoo Saturn 3 Ultra - 12K Resin 3D Printer with 10-inch Screen
short_description: MSLA resin printer with 12K resolution and a 10-inch screen for a large build area. Print speeds up to 150mm/hour with built-in air filtration. Best for large, high-detail resin prints.

name: eSUN PLA+ Filament 10-Color Pack - 10kg Total for 3D Printing
short_description: Ten 1kg spools of PLA+ filament in ten different colors. 1.75mm diameter with ±0.03mm tolerance. Stronger than standard PLA with easy printability. Massive savings vs individual spools.

name: Creality K1 Max - Large Format 3D Printer at 600mm/s
short_description: FDM printer with massive 300×300×300mm build volume and 600mm/s top speed. Built-in AI camera with zero-manual-leveling. The largest fast printer in its price class.

name: Bambu Lab AMS - Automatic Material System for Multi-Color 3D Printing
short_description: Automatic filament switching system supporting 4 spools. Print with four colors or materials in a single print. Compatible with Bambu Lab P1S and X1C printers.

name: Bambu Lab P1S 3D Printer - Blazing Speed and Pro Quality in an Enclosed Design
short_description: Fully enclosed FDM printer with speeds up to 500mm/s. AMS-compatible auto filament system with auto leveling and AI camera monitoring. The fastest printer in its class.
